page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.3xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. This x86_64 architecture server features 12 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, delivering a total of 12 vCPUs. It is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks position this instance primarily in the average tier for multi-core operations, while single-core performance is relatively weak. Single-core stress-ng and compression tests fall into the bottom 25% of benchmarks, whereas multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores consistently rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests, including cached and uncached reads and writes, also demonstrate average tier performance, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache and hardware acceleration flags such as AVX-512 and AES.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a balanced compute-heavy profile without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU accelerators. This resource density makes the instance suitable for workloads that require dedicated processing power but have moderate memory footprints. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
